title: Learning Tingatinga Painting in Dar es Salaam
excerpt: Tingatinga is Tanzania's colourful painting style. Where it comes from and how you can learn it in Dar es Salaam.
body:
## The origin

Tingatinga painting is named after Edward Saidi Tingatinga, who started painting in Dar es Salaam in the 1960s. His style was bright, with animals and simple forms, painted on board with bicycle paint.

## The style

Bold colours, animals, birds, daily life and a lot of detail. Today many artists work in the style.

## Where to see it

The Tingatinga Arts Cooperative in Dar es Salaam is the best-known place. Paintings are also sold on Zanzibar and in Arusha.

## Workshops

Some artists offer short painting workshops. A fun activity for families.

## Buying

Buying directly from artists supports them.

See [Dar es Salaam](/blog/dar-es-salaam-guide/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
